_note: Calories consumed and steps taken, per officer and per day. Filed each day on the Habitat tab of mission control (Steps taken, Calories consumed), or written here as "1": { "crew": { "COMMUNICATION OFFICER": { "calories": 1720, "steps": 2200 }, "SCIENCE OFFICER": { … }, "HEALTH OFFICER": { … } }, "calories": 5010, "steps": 6420 } — the two totals being the sums. A day left out records nothing; that is not the same as recording a zero. Emptied by the reset.
